description: Input.render returns %VRow{children: [text(before), %VCursor{style: :bar}, text(after)]} — the component never tracks screen coordinates. Painter stamps {row, col, style} via LineBuf.mark_cursor/2; LineBuf.finalize/1 returns {iodata, cursor_or_nil}. Renderer.render/4 builds cursor_seq from the stamped position when present, emits hide-cursor sequence when absent. IME/composition chunks emit their own VCursor and last-paint-wins. Tests: cursor follows nested VBox padding offsets; multi-VCursor last-wins; absent VCursor produces hide sequence.
title: Cursor-as-VNode: Input emits VCursor; renderer derives cursor_seq from buffer
